Header: Yellow Mosaic Virus Vernacular Name: ManjalThemalNoi

Prevention: Selection of improved black gram ( Vigna mungo ) resistant varieties such as
Avoid sowing in acute summer months (April-May).
Avoid dense sowing and follow the recommended spacing of 30 x 10 cm.
Maintain proper field sanitation and free weed flora field.
Washing the plants especially under surface of leaves by using low volume sprayer.
Careful removal and destruction of infected plant portions during infection early stage.
Placing of yellow sticky traps at 20/acre or light traps at 1 per acre to attract and kill the vector whiteflies.
Sowing of barrier crops, such as sorghum, maize, or cumbu in bunds
Avoid application of nitrogenous fertilizers during growth phase.
Monitoring: Careful monitoring of the whitefly vector ( Bemisia tabaci ) incidence during the early phase of crop growth (up to 30 days).
Close observation of the leaf surface and adopt the plant protection measures when the
Direct Control: Spraying of 10% Vitex negundo (Nochi leaf) extract (or) 1% tobacco leaf extract.
Spraying of 5% neem seed kernel extract or 3% neem oil.
Acetamiprid 20% SP @ 0.5 grams/ litre of water.
Restrictions: Severally infected plants turn yellow and sterile hence, no chemical is effective at this stage.
Systemic with contact and stomach action.
